label: Grounded Indigenous land-centered metaphysics in Syilx En’owkin pedagogy
description: Sharing Deloria’s emphasis on place-based Indigenous knowledge, Armstrong formalized the Syilx Okanagan En’owkin ecological consensus process.
dialecticalTension: Translates spatial metaphysics into participatory land-language education.

label: Pioneered Indigenous land-language reciprocity echoed in Kimmerer’s work
description: Armstrong’s insistence that Indigenous languages encode ecological obligations directly complements Kimmerer’s grammar of animacy.
dialecticalTension: Connects Syilx ecological philosophy with Potawatomi botanical ethics.
historicalContext: Contemporary North American Indigenous environmental philosophy.
